:::{#exm-fitting-procedure}
#### Inputs of least-squares polynomial fitting

The least-squares [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$ for polynomials of degree $\polydeg$ is specified by these inputs:

- [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$: the polynomials of degree at most $\polydeg$;
- [objective function](#def-objective-function) $\objfn$: the [residual sum of squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-rss);
- [optimization algorithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/optimization.html#def-optimization-algorithm) $\optalg$: solving the [normal equations](correlation-regression.qmd#def-normal-equations);
- [random seed](#def-random-seed) $\seed$: none, since nothing is random;
- [tuning parameter](#def-tuning-parameter) $\tuning$: the degree $\polydeg$;
- [preprocessing](#def-preprocessing) $\featmap$: none.

:::
